about: About FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE The full remake of the second installment in the FATAL FRAME series titled FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly.
This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters who become lost in an abandoned village haunted by vengeful spirits.
Using the Camera Obscura—a device that can capture and seal away the impossible—they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.
This title has undergone a complete overhaul, with improvements to everything from visuals and audio to the core gameplay systems and controls.
The signature Camera Obscura mechanic, used to capture and fend off spirits, remains a key feature, now offering richer and more engaging gameplay in both exploration and combat.
